name: Stanford AIMI Summer Research Internship
org: Stanford Center for Artificial Intelligence in Medicine and Imaging (AIMI)
what_you_do: You work in small teams with Stanford mentors on a health AI research project. You use medical data, share your results and hear talks. The program is online.
who_can_apply: Students entering grades 9 to 12 in fall 2027, in the U.S. or abroad. You must be older than 14 when your session starts. Strong programming skills are needed.
pay_detail: Tuition is $3,000 and is not refundable. No application fee. Need-based aid is for students who live in the U.S.
duration: 2 weeks online, Mon to Fri, 9 am to 1 pm Pacific. Session A is June 14 to 25, 2027. Session B is July 12 to 23, 2027.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 program. Application opens Nov 10, 2026 and closes Feb 1, 2027. The application is open now and due Feb 1, 2027. Aid applications close Jan 15, 2027.
how_to_apply: The application is open now and due Feb 1, 2027. Use the apply link on the program page. Questions: aimi-hs-programs@stanford.edu.
notes: As of Nov 11, 2026 the page lists tuition, two session dates and eligibility for the Summer 2027 program. Recommendations are due Feb 8, 2027. Decisions come by the end of March 2027. The page does not say whether a work permit is needed. Ask aimi-hs-programs@stanford.edu. The Summer Health AI Bootcamp is a separate program on the same site and is not covered here.
